venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Thursday 8/6.** MOD MKZ // JK. Net $2,675 vs $2,129 target (+25.6%). 78 guests // $34.29 check avg. Comps $35.80 (Bingo Credit $5, F&F $6, O4W $8.80, Service Recovery $16). Mellow start — school back in session, tropical-summer storms — 5 Meal Deals early, then a quick pickup after 8pm with a nice guest-flow spike at 9pm. Moonlight didn't honor a group's 15-top reservation, so the group came to CC ATL instead. Opener cut just before 8pm; barback prepped batches for the weekend. New hire Jayden's 4th shift and first close (with Mya) — reviewed Batch Prep, Guest Maintenance & Hospitality guides and jumped right in. Kitchen: prep/ABK for the weekend. Maintenance: BOH hand-wash sink clogged (aerator soaking in Cafiza). 86: Cambio Reposado, 400 Conejos Mezcal — push G4 Reposado. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: meeting JW from Like Minds down the Beltline.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Thursday 8/6.** MOD KK/MD/KE & JMS. Net $1,501 vs $3,669 target (-59.1%). ~58 guests & $25.88 check avg. Comps $19.30 / 1.3% (Employee, Industry, F&F, Neuhoff Resident). Slower-paced Thursday — only ~$350 in sales by 7pm; majority of sales came 9-10:30pm (dates, friend groups, a birthday group, industry friends). Lower food sales; some meal deals and misc. food later. JMS held down BOH and helped the floor. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: Emma from NYC (has visited EV and DC) made a point to visit CC Nash on her one night in town — called her Adventure Gimlet and Mini Super Martini a martini redemption.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Thursday 8/6.** AM Maggie S & Chef Josh; PM Evan F & Chef Lucas. Net $9,567.32 vs $11,291 target (-15.3%). DC/AM $1,203.91, D&C PM $8,363.41, Garden/6A $2,370.03. Food $1,945. Comps $200.30 (2.09%). 169 guests (Tock). AM steady with a nice cocktail hour late; PM pretty slow overall but strong food attach among those who came; Garden very chill. Kitchen chill (Lucas, Nate, Marv). Incident reported: yes — a couple service recoveries and one nuisance guest asked to leave. Maintenance: left Mezz-to-Garden door (near photo booth) sticking. No-shows not charged.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Thursday 8/6** (submitted 8/10, backfilled). MOD Kyler & Steves. Net $11,836 incl. events vs $6,150 target (+92.5%). D&C net excl. events $1,836 (food $20 / beverage $1,775 / retail $40); Event sales $10,000. 68 guests / $33 check avg. Comps $57.20 (3%). Private influencer book-release party of 50 from 5:30–10:30pm celebrating the third book of a Christmas-themed trilogy; 12 guests did a cocktail class beforehand — very smooth event. Reopened 10:30pm and filled the room off a walk-up line within a half hour; full until 12:30am then a quiet close. Past EV AGM Courtney visited, plus industry friends Gabriel (Wayland) and Milos (Kafana). No-shows: Alejandro Sanz (3, 10:30pm), Stephanie Candillo (2, 10:45pm), not charged.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Thursday 8/6.** MOD Gigi & Saleh. Net $5,916 vs $6,174 target (-4.2%). Marquee $5,916 (food $1,155); Standing Room $0. 142 guests; report lists GCA $100.16 (net/guests computes to $41.66). Comps $262 (employee food discount, food tasting, Huy, Carie, member Brett Dahlenburg, industry regular Mark, DNLs). Wonderful evening — slow start gave Natalie time to train new hosts Ariana and Analise, who were seating solo within hours. Picked up ~9:30pm and filled the room; lively industry-heavy bar; party of 10 filled the 20s. Fire alarm went off again (recurring). Maintenance: prep lowboy + kitchen freezer. 86 popcorn. No incidents; no-shows charged. Favorite moment: food tasting with Natalie, Analise and Ariana.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Thursday 8/6.** MOD Marcus. Net $4,496.11 vs $5,215 target (-13.8%). Marquee bar sales $4,953.17; food $524; Garden closed (heat). Comps $60.54 (community/investor $44.54, DNL $6, gift $10). 112 guests (73 walk-in / 39 reso); GCA $41.63. Gradual build with biggest pop ~7pm, room nearly full by 7:30, steady turns until 10. Last-minute call-out forced an on-the-fly floor restructure — Tyler held the floor, Devan and Chaz moved from hosting, Marcus took the host stand; bar team (Ian, Ben, Jada) crushed support. Chaz's third training day going great with Devan mentoring. Bar top refilled at 12:15, last call 12:30. Incident reported: yes. Maintenance: kitchen lowboy cover needs a hinge. No-shows not charged. Favorite moment: Callum visiting.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Thursday 8/6.** AM Braden & Lex; PM James & Marcus. Net $5,157 vs $4,000 target (+28.9%). Municipal Bar AM $820 (30 guests) / PM $3,445 (72 guests); Sun Club $5; Hot Eye $907. Food $1,263. Comps $190. Slow AM — fire-alarm testing and septic-pump maintenance made the lobby loud/smelly early; Hutch dresses photoshoot was a fun production. Evening good-slow; two servers all night, briefly hectic but handled; bar fairly busy with locals and repeat out-of-towners. Sun Club: one beer sold — brutal heat then thunderstorms; deep ABK of lounge chairs and storage; needs lemon, lime, pineapple juice and simple syrup. Hot Eye quiet but steady — hotel guests and industry, incl. friend Olly's birthday. Kitchen: small 7-8pm pop; 86 pickled onions only. No incidents. Favorite moment: MG staff coming down to celebrate Olly's birthday in THE.
